subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A week later, she received it at home and smiled.”?
options: Sometimes the nose opens memory faster than words.
Sometimes a small change helps more people than we first think.
Sometimes usefulness changes with time, but it does not always disappear.
A postcard moves slowly, but sometimes slow words arrive more deeply.
